item.description: Complete API Gateway demonstration suite. Start Product Service (8081), Inventory Service (8082), Order Service (8083), and API Gateway (8080). Run requests in numeric order. Some failure tests require temporarily stopping or slowing a downstream service as described in each request.

Verifies that Product, Inventory, and Order routes are registered. Requires management.endpoint.gateway.access=read-only and the gateway Actuator endpoint to be exposed.
